The '''Malgan Market''' was a market on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] where many merchants and pedestrians walked.

==History==
Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], on the fifth day after the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]] came into [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]], they [[Death/Legends|destroyed]] several [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]] tossed an [[Electromagnetic pulse grenade/Legends|electromagnetic pulse grenade]] into a group of [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]], [[Saw Gerrera/Legends|Saw Gerrera]] shot a droid who was checking a civilian's ID, [[Steela Gerrera/Legends|Steela Gerrera]] shot a droid from a rooftop, and [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and [[Dono (Onderonian)/Legends|Dono]] took out a [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droid]].

While there were no civilian casualties or injuries during this attack, the public was still very alarmed at the situation.
